turns.question: How many MQLs did paid social bring in during September 2026?
turns.answer:
The data can't answer this. I found no MQL definition or qualification field anywhere in the catalog or the schemas. A search for "MQL" returned nothing. The leads data (`silver.leads`) holds only the lead ID, campaign, creation date and country, with no marketing-qualified flag or lead stage. The business only defines "Leads", meaning all CRM leads created. I haven't counted all paid-social leads for September 2026 as a stand-in, because that would be a different number from MQLs.

If you give me the MQL criteria, or tell me to use all leads as the proxy, I can run the count.
